accept.zh-CN: 接受上传的文件类型，写法同 input 的 accept：文件后缀（如 `.jpg`）或 MIME type，用逗号分隔。
accept.en-US: Accepted file types, written like the accept attribute of input: file extensions such as `.jpg` or MIME types, separated by commas.

addOnPasting.zh-CN: 粘贴（paste 事件）时是否把剪贴板中的文件加入文件列表，无需额外授权。
addOnPasting.en-US: Whether files in the clipboard are added to the file list on paste, without extra permission.

afterUpload.zh-CN: 上传完成且没有出错后的钩子，根据返回的对象更新文件状态、校验信息、名称和预览地址；不支持异步返回。
afterUpload.en-US: Hook after an upload completes without error. The returned object updates the file status, validate message, name and preview URL. Async results are not supported.

beforeClear.zh-CN: 清空文件前的回调，返回 false、resolve(false) 或 reject 会阻止清空。
beforeClear.en-US: Called before the list is cleared. Returning false, or a Promise that resolves to false or rejects, blocks the clear.

beforeCrop.zh-CN: 图片裁切前的回调，只用第一张选中的图片调用一次，结果决定整批是否裁切。返回 false 跳过裁切直接上传，支持异步返回。
beforeCrop.en-US: Called before the crop modal opens, once with the first selected image; the result decides cropping for the whole batch. Return false to upload without cropping. May return a Promise.

beforeRemove.zh-CN: 移除文件前的回调，返回 false、resolve(false) 或 reject 会阻止移除。
beforeRemove.en-US: Called before a file is removed. Returning false, or a Promise that resolves to false or rejects, blocks the removal.

beforeUpload.zh-CN: 上传文件前的钩子，根据返回的对象更新文件状态并控制是否上传；返回 boolean 表示通过或失败，返回 Promise 时 resolve 为通过、reject 为失败。
beforeUpload.en-US: Hook before a file is uploaded. The returned object updates the file status and decides whether to upload. A boolean means pass or fail; for a Promise, resolve passes and reject fails.

capture.zh-CN: 媒体拍摄的方式，可选 user、environment；传 true 输出空值属性，传 false 不输出该属性。
capture.en-US: How media is captured: user or environment. true renders the attribute with an empty value, false omits it.

crop.zh-CN: 启用图片裁切。传 true 使用默认配置，传对象自定义裁切参数；点击选择、拖拽、粘贴、替换都会裁切。
crop.en-US: Enables image cropping. true uses the defaults, an object configures the cropper. Selecting, dragging, pasting and replacing all crop.

cropModalProps.zh-CN: 裁切弹窗 Modal 的属性；visible、title、okText、cancelText、onOk、onCancel 由组件内置，width 缺省为 600。
cropModalProps.en-US: Props of the crop Modal. visible, title, okText, cancelText, onOk and onCancel belong to Upload; width defaults to 600.

customRequest.zh-CN: 替换内置 XMLHttpRequest 的自定义请求方法，需自行调用入参的 onProgress、onError、onSuccess 更新状态。
customRequest.en-US: Replaces the built-in XMLHttpRequest. It must call the onProgress, onError and onSuccess it receives to update the state.

data.zh-CN: 上传时附带的额外参数，或根据文件返回额外参数的函数。
data.en-US: Extra parameters sent with the upload, or a function that returns them for a file.

defaultFileList.zh-CN: 初始的已上传文件列表，非受控。每项的 uid 必填且不能重复。
defaultFileList.en-US: Initial list of uploaded files, uncontrolled. The uid of every item is required and must be unique.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。禁用后不再显示移除、重试、替换和清空操作。
disabled.en-US: Whether Upload is disabled. A disabled Upload no longer shows the remove, retry, replace and clear actions.

draggable.en-US: Whether dragging files to upload is supported.

fileList.zh-CN: 受控的文件列表，配合 v-model:fileList 使用。每项的 uid 必填且不能重复。
fileList.en-US: Controlled file list, used with v-model:fileList. The uid of every item is required and must be unique.

fileName.zh-CN: 作用与 name 相同，主要在 Form.Upload 中使用，避免与 Field 的 name 冲突。
fileName.en-US: Same as name. Mainly used in Form.Upload to avoid clashing with the name of Field.

headers.zh-CN: 上传时附带的 headers，或根据文件返回 headers 的函数。
headers.en-US: Headers sent with the upload, or a function that returns them for a file.

hotSpotLocation.zh-CN: 照片墙添加按钮的位置，可选 start 或 end。
hotSpotLocation.en-US: Position of the picture wall add button: start or end.

itemStyle.en-US: Inline style of the file cards.

limit.zh-CN: 最多允许上传的文件个数。为 1 时始终用最新选择的文件替换当前文件，不触发 exceed。
limit.en-US: Maximum number of files. With 1, the newest file always replaces the current one and exceed is not emitted.

listType.zh-CN: 文件列表的展示类型，可选 list、picture、none；none 不渲染文件列表，只保留触发区。
listType.en-US: How the file list is displayed: list, picture or none. none renders no file list, only the trigger area.

maxSize.zh-CN: 文件体积上限，单位 KB。

minSize.zh-CN: 文件体积下限，单位 KB。

multiple.zh-CN: 是否允许一次选择多个文件。
multiple.en-US: Whether several files can be selected at once.

name.zh-CN: 上传时使用的文件字段名。
name.en-US: Field name used for the file when uploading.

onPreviewClick.zh-CN: 监听方式为 @previewClick。传入后文件卡片可点击，并显示预览按钮；是否传入会改变渲染，因此保留为函数 prop。
onPreviewClick.en-US: Listened to as @previewClick. While present the file cards are clickable and show a preview button; its presence changes the rendering, so it stays a function prop.

picHeight.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的展示高度。
picHeight.en-US: Display height of the pictures in picture mode.

picWidth.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的展示宽度。
picWidth.en-US: Display width of the pictures in picture mode.

promptPosition.zh-CN: 提示文本的位置，可选 left、right、bottom。list 模式相对触发区，picture 模式相对图片列表。
promptPosition.en-US: Position of the prompt: left, right or bottom. In list mode it is relative to the trigger, in picture mode to the picture list.

showClear.zh-CN: list 模式下，limit 不为 1 且至少有一个文件时，是否展示清空按钮。
showClear.en-US: In list mode, whether to show the clear button when limit is not 1 and there is at least one file.

showPicInfo.zh-CN: 是否显示图片信息，只在照片墙模式下有效。
showPicInfo.en-US: Whether to show picture information. Only applies in picture mode.

showReplace.zh-CN: 上传成功后，文件卡片内是否展示替换按钮。
showReplace.en-US: Whether the file card shows a replace button after a successful upload.

showRetry.zh-CN: 上传失败时，文件卡片内是否展示重试按钮。
showRetry.en-US: Whether the file card shows a retry button when the upload fails.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 文件名过长时是否展示提示，或配置提示的类型（tooltip 或 popover）和透传属性；自定义弹出内容使用 ellipsisTooltip 插槽。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a truncated file name shows a tooltip, or the tooltip type (tooltip or popover) and the props passed to it. Use the ellipsisTooltip slot for custom popup content.

showUploadList.en-US: Whether to show the file list.

transformFile.zh-CN: 选中文件后、上传前的转换函数，返回要上传的 File。
transformFile.en-US: Called after a file is selected and before it is uploaded; returns the File to upload.

uploadTrigger.zh-CN: 触发上传的时机，auto 选中后自动上传，custom 需调用 upload 方法。
uploadTrigger.en-US: When uploading starts: auto uploads on selection, custom waits for the upload method.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，影响根元素的样式，可选 default、error、warning、success。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which styles the root element: default, error, warning or success.

withCredentials.zh-CN: 上传请求是否携带 Cookie。
withCredentials.en-US: Whether the upload request carries cookies.

update:fileList.zh-CN: 文件列表变化时触发，用于 v-model:fileList。
update:fileList.en-US: Emitted when the file list changes. Backs v-model:fileList.

acceptInvalid.zh-CN: 接收到的文件不符合 accept 时触发，参数为不符合的文件。
acceptInvalid.en-US: Emitted when received files do not match accept, with those files.

change.zh-CN: 文件状态变化时触发，包括上传中、成功、失败。currentFile 在 insert 后为 null，清空时不带。会遮住隐藏 input 冒泡出来的原生 change。
change.en-US: Emitted when a file status changes, including uploading, success and failure. currentFile is null after insert and absent after a clear. Shadows the native change bubbling from the hidden input.

clear.en-US: Emitted after the list is cleared.

cropError.en-US: Emitted when cropping an image fails.

drop.zh-CN: 拖拽的元素在拖拽区上释放时触发，参数为原生 drop 事件、拖入的文件和当前文件列表。会遮住根元素上的原生 drop。
drop.en-US: Emitted when a dragged element is released on the drag area, with the native drop event, the dropped files and the current file list. Shadows the native drop on the root element.

error.zh-CN: 上传出错时触发。使用 customRequest 时，xhr 是使用方传给 onError 的对象。
error.en-US: Emitted when an upload fails. With customRequest, xhr is the object passed to its onError.

exceed.zh-CN: 文件总数超出 limit 时触发，参数为截断前本次选中的原始文件。
exceed.en-US: Emitted when the total number of files exceeds limit, with the originally selected files before truncation.

openFileDialog.zh-CN: 打开系统文件选择窗口时触发。
openFileDialog.en-US: Emitted when the system file dialog opens.

pastingError.zh-CN: addOnPasting 为 true 且读取剪贴板中的文件失败时触发。
pastingError.en-US: Emitted when addOnPasting is true and a clipboard file cannot be read.

progress.zh-CN: 上传过程中触发，参数为百分比、文件和当前文件列表。
progress.en-US: Emitted while uploading, with the percentage, the file and the current file list.

remove.zh-CN: 移除文件后触发。来自 defaultFileList 且没有 File 对象的项，currentFile 为 undefined。
remove.en-US: Emitted after a file is removed. currentFile is undefined for an item without a File object, such as one from defaultFileList.

sizeError.zh-CN: 文件体积不符合 maxSize 或 minSize 时触发。
sizeError.en-US: Emitted when a file size violates maxSize or minSize.

success.zh-CN: 上传成功后触发，参数为服务端响应、文件和当前文件列表。
success.en-US: Emitted after a successful upload, with the server response, the file and the current file list.

default.zh-CN: 触发区内容。拖拽模式下替换整个默认拖拽区内容。
default.en-US: Trigger content. In draggable mode it replaces the whole default drag area content.

dragIcon.zh-CN: 拖拽区的图标，渲染为空时显示默认图标。
dragIcon.en-US: Icon of the drag area. Falls back to the default icon when empty.

dragMainText.zh-CN: 拖拽区的主文本，渲染为空时显示语言包文案。
dragMainText.en-US: Main text of the drag area. Falls back to the locale text when empty.

dragSubText.en-US: Help text of the drag area.

prompt.zh-CN: 提示文本。与写在默认插槽中不同，点击它不会触发上传。
prompt.en-US: Prompt text. Unlike content in the default slot, clicking it does not trigger an upload.

validateMessage.en-US: Validate message of the whole Upload.

fileListTitle.zh-CN: 只替换文件列表的标题文字，保留清空按钮。
fileListTitle.en-US: Replaces only the title text of the file list; the clear button stays.

fileListHeader.zh-CN: 替换整个标题区（含清空按钮），参数为 fileList、onClear、clearText。
fileListHeader.en-US: Replaces the whole title area, clear button included, with fileList, onClear and clearText.

fileItem.zh-CN: 替换每张文件卡片，参数为 UploadFileItemSlotProps；对某个文件渲染为空时不显示该文件。
fileItem.en-US: Replaces each file card, with UploadFileItemSlotProps. A file it renders nothing for is not shown.

previewFile.zh-CN: 自定义预览逻辑，替换原缩略图，只在 list 模式下有效；渲染为空时不回落默认缩略图。
previewFile.en-US: Custom preview that replaces the thumbnail. Only applies in list mode. It does not fall back to the default thumbnail when empty.

thumbnail.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙缩略图，只在照片墙模式下有效。
thumbnail.en-US: Custom picture wall thumbnail. Only applies in picture mode.

picInfo.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙信息，只在照片墙模式且 showPicInfo 为 true 时有效。
picInfo.en-US: Custom picture wall information. Only applies in picture mode with showPicInfo set to true.

picPreviewIcon.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙悬停时的预览图标，只在照片墙模式下有效。
picPreviewIcon.en-US: Custom preview icon shown on hover in the picture wall. Only applies in picture mode.

picClose.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙的关闭按钮，参数为 class 和 onRemove，只在照片墙模式下有效。
picClose.en-US: Custom close button of the picture wall, with class and onRemove. Only applies in picture mode.

fileOperation.zh-CN: 自定义列表项的操作区。
fileOperation.en-US: Custom operation area of a list item.

fileValidateMessage.zh-CN: 自定义文件卡片的校验信息，渲染为空时回落到文件自身的 validateMessage 字符串。
fileValidateMessage.en-US: Custom validate message of a file card. Falls back to the validateMessage string of the file when empty.

ellipsisTooltip.zh-CN: 自定义文件名过长时的弹出内容，参数为 content 和 trigger。
ellipsisTooltip.en-US: Custom popup content for a truncated file name, with content and trigger.

insert.zh-CN: 在 index 位置插入文件，不传 index 则插入到末尾。
insert.en-US: Adds files at index, or at the end without one.

upload.zh-CN: 开始上传等待中的文件，配合 uploadTrigger 为 custom 使用。
upload.en-US: Uploads the waiting files. Use it with uploadTrigger set to custom.

index.en-US: Position of the file in the list.

listType.zh-CN: 卡片的展示类型，可选 list、picture、none；none 不渲染卡片。
listType.en-US: Display type of the card: list, picture or none. none renders no card.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，禁用后不显示移除、重试和替换按钮。
disabled.en-US: Whether the card is disabled. A disabled card shows no remove, retry or replace button.

showRetry.zh-CN: 上传失败时是否展示重试按钮，文件自身的 showRetry 优先。
showRetry.en-US: Whether to show a retry button on failure. The showRetry of the file wins.

showReplace.zh-CN: 上传成功后是否展示替换按钮，文件自身的 showReplace 优先。
showReplace.en-US: Whether to show a replace button after success. The showReplace of the file wins.

showPicInfo.zh-CN: 是否显示图片信息，只在照片墙模式下有效。
showPicInfo.en-US: Whether to show picture information. Only applies in picture mode.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 文件名过长时是否展示提示，或配置提示的类型和透传属性。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a truncated file name shows a tooltip, or the tooltip type and the props passed to it.

picWidth.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的宽度。
picWidth.en-US: Width of the picture in picture mode.

picHeight.zh-CN: 照片墙模式下图片的高度。
picHeight.en-US: Height of the picture in picture mode.

validateMessage.zh-CN: 校验信息，优先于文件自身的 validateMessage。
validateMessage.en-US: Validate message. Wins over the validateMessage of the file.

onPreviewClick.zh-CN: 监听方式为 @previewClick。传入后卡片可点击，并显示预览按钮；是否传入会改变渲染，因此保留为函数 prop。
onPreviewClick.en-US: Listened to as @previewClick. While present the card is clickable and shows a preview button; its presence changes the rendering, so it stays a function prop.

previewFile.zh-CN: 自定义预览逻辑，替换原缩略图，只在 list 模式下有效。
previewFile.en-US: Custom preview that replaces the thumbnail. Only applies in list mode.

thumbnail.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙缩略图，只在照片墙模式下有效。
thumbnail.en-US: Custom picture wall thumbnail. Only applies in picture mode.

picInfo.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙信息，只在照片墙模式且 showPicInfo 为 true 时有效。
picInfo.en-US: Custom picture wall information. Only applies in picture mode with showPicInfo set to true.

picPreviewIcon.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙悬停时的预览图标，只在照片墙模式下有效。
picPreviewIcon.en-US: Custom preview icon shown on hover in the picture wall. Only applies in picture mode.

picClose.zh-CN: 自定义照片墙的关闭按钮，参数为 class 和 onRemove，只在照片墙模式下有效。
picClose.en-US: Custom close button of the picture wall, with class and onRemove. Only applies in picture mode.

fileOperation.zh-CN: 自定义列表项的操作区。
fileOperation.en-US: Custom operation area of a list item.

validateMessage.zh-CN: 自定义校验信息，渲染为空时回落到字符串。插槽为该文件渲染出内容时，图片墙同样显示校验图标。
validateMessage.en-US: Custom validate message. Falls back to the string when empty. When the slot renders content for the file, the picture wall shows the validate icon too.

ellipsisTooltip.zh-CN: 自定义文件名过长时的弹出内容，参数为 content 和 trigger。
ellipsisTooltip.en-US: Custom popup content for a truncated file name, with content and trigger.
